newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Grand Orient falls on rights issue plan.
newsitem.headline: Grand Orient falls on rights issue plan.

text.p: Shares of Grand Orient Holdings Ltd fell on dilution fears after the company announced a one-for-one rights issue of shares, brokers said on Monday.
"Dilution fear had put pressure on the shares," said a sales manager at a regional brokerage. "I think it should gain support later when the trading gap with its rights share price narrows."
The company's shares fell HK$0.35 or 17.95 percent to HK$1.60 in late morning on volume of 1.79 million shares worth HK$2.89 million.

The property and securities investment concern said earlier it planned to raise HK$358 million before expenses through a rights of 275.49 million new shares in the proportion of one rights share for every existing share at HK$1.30 each.
Grand Orient said it would use the proceed to upgrade and enlarge its property portfolio in Hong Kong and China, to repay bank debt and for working capital.
